finding: On 2026-10-26 at 18:04Z, with no credentials, mcp.allium.so answered GET and an MCP initialize 503 with a 256-byte Google Frontend page reading 'Service is disabled', with no authentication challenge; mcp-oauth.allium.so and both well-known metadata documents answered the same. This is the first reading of this surface since 2026-09-11 that is neither 200 nor 401: 200 with 48 tools listed to a stranger until 2026-09-28 06:31Z, 401 with a bearer-scheme challenge from 2026-09-28 18:04Z through 2026-10-20, 503 today. The machine-payments host answered as filed in the same minute, so the tool's accountless path is unaffected. The vendor's documentation, re-read the same minute and dated October 2026, names mcp.allium.so as the one server URL for every client and deprecates mcp-oauth.allium.so after 31 October 2026; nothing read announces a pause or a shutdown of the surviving host, so whether this is a redeploy or a retirement is not established.
